title: Authentic British Beef Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with tender beef and rich flavors. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking continuously, and bring to a boil.
Add the browned beef, red wine (if using), brown sugar, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve hot over mashed potatoes, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
